001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.rulecmd;
002
003import java.util.List;
004import java.util.Map;
005
006import java.awt.Color;
007
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.CampaignFleetAPI;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.CargoStackAPI;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.InteractionDialogAPI;
012import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.TextPanelAPI;
013import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.rules.MemKeys;
014import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.rules.MemoryAPI;
015import com.fs.starfarer.api.fleet.FleetMemberAPI;
016import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Strings;
017import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.rulecmd.CargoScan.CargoScanResult;
018import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.Misc;
019import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.Misc.Token;
020
021public class CargoScanApplyResult extends BaseCommandPlugin {
022
023        
024        public boolean execute(String ruleId, InteractionDialogAPI dialog, List<Token> params, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
025                if (dialog == null) return false;
026                if (!(dialog.getInteractionTarget() instanceof CampaignFleetAPI)) return false;
027                
028                CampaignFleetAPI playerFleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
029                CampaignFleetAPI other = (CampaignFleetAPI) dialog.getInteractionTarget();
030                
031                MemoryAPI memory = memoryMap.get(MemKeys.LOCAL);
032                
033                CargoScanResult result = (CargoScanResult) memory.get(CargoScan.RESULT_KEY);
034                
035                TextPanelAPI text = dialog.getTextPanel();
036                Color red = Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor();
037                
038                for (CargoStackAPI stack : result.getIllegalFound().getStacksCopy()) {
039                        playerFleet.getCargo().removeItems(stack.getType(), stack.getData(), stack.getSize());
040                        if (stack.isCommodityStack()) {
041                                AddRemoveCommodity.addCommodityLossText(stack.getCommodityId(), (int)stack.getSize(), text);
042                        } else {
043                                text.setFontSmallInsignia();
044                                text.addParagraph("Lost " + (int) stack.getSize() + Strings.X + " " + stack.getDisplayName(), red);
045                                text.highlightLastInLastPara("" + (int) stack.getSize() + Strings.X, Misc.getHighlightColor());
046                        }
047                        text.setFontInsignia();
048                }
049                
050                for (FleetMemberAPI member : result.shipsToDamage) {
051                        float crLost = Math.min(member.getRepairTracker().getBaseCR(), member.getDeployCost() * 0.5f);
052                        crLost += 0.01f * (float)Misc.random.nextInt(10);
053                        
054                        if (Misc.isExtended()) {
055                                crLost *= Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_cargoScanShipDamageMult");
056                        }
057                        
058                        if (crLost > 0) {
059                                member.getRepairTracker().applyCREvent(-crLost, "Vindictive cargo inspection");
060                                AddRemoveCommodity.addCRLossText(member, text, crLost);
061                        }
062                        
063                }
064                
065                return true;
066        }
067
068}
